subject.title: [BUG] drive list/info ignore pagination; info falsely reports File not found past page 1

question: Should Feishu Drive `info` add an optional concrete `folder_token` and paginate only within that folder, or should a different lookup contract be used for files beyond the first page?
rationale: Current main intentionally avoids automatic root draining, and the existing `info` schema has no folder context, so the permanent tool contract affects user-facing behavior and proof expectations.

options.title: Add folder-scoped info pagination
options.body: Expose `folder_token` for `info`, paginate through that folder using `has_more` and `next_page_token`, and keep root/no-folder behavior bounded with clear proof.

options.title: Use another lookup contract
options.body: Choose a different supported Feishu lookup path if maintainers do not want `info` to depend on folder-scoped list pagination.

options.title: Defer and keep documented limitation
options.body: Keep this issue open or narrow it to docs until a live Feishu tenant proof path is available.

recommendation.title: Add folder-scoped info pagination
recommendation.body: Expose `folder_token` for `info`, paginate through that folder using `has_more` and `next_page_token`, and keep root/no-folder behavior bounded with clear proof.

likelyOwner.reason: This person authored the current list fix and already documented the intended split between list continuation and the remaining `info` contract.
